questions.prompt: A helper adds the current time to the messages array right before the request, without appending an event. What breaks?
options: The model cannot read the time
The request can no longer be rebuilt from the session, so a later reader cannot explain the answer
The sequence numbers get a gap
The tool result loses its call id
questions.explanation: The model saw the time but the session has no event for it. Anyone who rebuilds the request from the session gets a different request from the one sent.

questions.prompt: How can a test check that the rule holds?
options: Count the events and compare the count to the number of requests
Check that every event has a time
Compare each saved request with the messages built from the events that existed at that moment
Check that the model never uses a tool twice
questions.explanation: If every input was logged, building messages from the events reproduces each sent request exactly. Any difference shows an input that skipped the session.

questions.prompt: In runStep, why is the tool result appended as an event instead of pushed to an array?
options: So the next request, built from the session, contains it
Because arrays cannot hold tool results
Because the model reads the session file directly
questions.explanation: The next request is built only from the session. A result that is not an event would never reach the model.
